researchQuestion: Does exact current-main contain exactly one native, deterministic, Dusk-qualified, policy-visible and persistable exclusive-acquisition path outside every closed acquisition alias, so the next structural rung can reuse it without new orchestration or a breaking contract?
competingOptions: freeze exactly one eligible native path shape for a later no-row package-design audit
record the native exclusive-acquisition path unavailable because no unique path satisfies every frozen rule
record the exact-source audit inconclusive at the frozen cap
claimBoundary: This is a source-feasibility audit of the smallest native-reuse rung. It may identify one existing function shape or prove none is eligible under the frozen one-function, policy-visible and closed-alias exclusions. It cannot establish that every imaginable new acquisition system is impossible, select content, design a package, implement, infer support or authorise a simulator row.

minimumNativeReuseRule.functionBoundary: One existing non-Pilot function block must already combine acquisition, explicit choice, aspect qualification, persistence and no RNG. Cross-function orchestration does not count because it would be a new acquisition system rather than native reuse.
minimumNativeReuseRule.policyVisibility: The exact Pilot must contain a choice-bearing acquisition block in the same classified path alias. A product-only choice that the research policy cannot express is ineligible.
minimumNativeReuseRule.closedAliasExclusion: Normal reward, shop, event, deed/unlock, boss relic, Lantern Art, removal and elite paths are ineligible because immutable decisions close those complete current-source route families. Fight-quality and Hearth evidence close the remaining tested trigger and natural-relic continuations.
minimumNativeReuseRule.persistence: The path must reuse a generic current RunState collection and generic save/content dictionary identity; no new save field, internal-ID representation or migration is allowed.
minimumNativeReuseRule.uniqueness: Exactly one block may pass. Zero means unavailable. More than one leaves a product-defining route choice absent from the SSOT and is also unavailable under this audit.

sourceClassification.parser: Deterministically split exact GDScript at top-level static or instance function declarations and classify lowercase literal substrings within each complete function block.
genericContractChecks: RunState source contains a generic relic collection
SaveService source uses a dictionary payload rather than a new candidate-specific schema field
ContentDB source uses string-keyed dictionaries rather than a closed candidate enum

factorBoundary.scorelinePayoff: Separate exact-current causal factor, fixed and unmodified.
factorBoundary.afterimagePayoff: Separate exact-current causal factor, fixed and unmodified.
factorBoundary.candidateAcquisition: No factor or level exists. A feasible path shape would still require a separate design and identity protocol.
factorBoundary.acquisitionPriority: Exact current and fixed; no policy method is authorised.
factorBoundary.designMatrix: No cells, anchors or causal contrasts. Zero simulator rows.
factorBoundary.futureRule: Any later experiment must separately freeze exact factor definitions, levels, matrix, shared Scoreline and Afterimage anchors, estimands, interactions, aliases, common policies and seeds, estimator and stop rule.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one non-Pilot function block combines acquisition, explicit choice, aspect qualification, persistence, no RNG, matching Pilot visibility and no closed alias; generic current RunState, save and content identity checks all pass.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the exact eligible native path shape for a separately preregistered zero-row package-design audit. Do not choose content, implement, inspect support, run Godot, simulate or infer efficacy.
decisionRules.futility: Zero or more than one native path passes, or the generic persistence contract is not exact.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and record native deterministic exclusive acquisition unavailable under the smallest current-source reuse rung. Do not loosen a closed alias, add a new acquisition/UI/save surface, repair a quarantine, select a product-defining route, add ML/RL/optimisation or simulate. Preserve the safe state and invoke the current human-authority contract because the relevant second-Dusk-package gate now requires either new product authority or a change to an immutable one-attempt boundary.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any source, evidence, task-capsule, parser, ledger or 30-second identity cannot be established.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the relevant source gate inconclusive without a candidate, implementation, support read, Godot process, simulator row, ML/RL, optimiser or protected seed. Preserve the safe state and invoke only the current human-authority contract.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns exact source loading, function inventory, alias classification and stop/go. The one-function requirement is the minimum native-reuse rung, not a claim over hypothetical new product systems. Issue 524 and 525 remain immutable evidence and are not reconstructed.
